learning_outcomes.text: Knows the parameters considered in engine design.
Has detailed knowledge about engine parts.
Knows the external loads to which engine parts are exposed.
Performs strength calculations for engine parts.
Knows what kind of materials are used in engine manufacturing.
Knows by what methods engine parts are manufactured.
Knows the latest innovations in engine design.

syllabus_topics: Methods used in determining main engine dimensions
Dimensioning of engine parts, manufacturing methods and materials used
Dimensioning and strength calculations of the piston
Materials and manufacturing methods used in piston production
Dimensioning, strength calculations, manufacturing methods and materials used for piston rings
Dimensioning, strength calculations, manufacturing methods and materials used for piston pin
Dimensioning, strength calculations, manufacturing methods and materials used for connecting rod
Dimensioning, strength calculations, manufacturing methods and materials used for crankshaft
Dimensioning, strength calculations, manufacturing methods and materials used for engine block and cylinder head
Dimensioning, strength calculations, manufacturing methods and materials used for camshaft
Dimensioning, strength calculations, manufacturing methods and materials used for valves and valve train systems
